text: Slept maybe four hours. Dragged myself through the day, my back is killing me and I've had a headache since noon.
Could not focus at all today. Read the same paragraph five times and still had no idea what it said. Brain feels like soup.
Snapped at my flatmate over nothing. I've been on the edge of tears all evening and I don't even know why.
Three people invited me out and I made excuses to all of them. I just want everyone to leave me alone.
Another day of pointless meetings. I genuinely don't care about the product anymore, I'm just going through the motions.
Haven't touched my guitar in two months. Every hour goes to work or chores and none of it is actually mine.
Good day honestly. Slept well, got through my task list, had lunch with a friend.
Exhausted after work and then had zero patience with my sister on the phone. Went to bed angry.
Worked till 11pm again. My eyes hurt and I couldn't think straight by the end but the deadline is Friday.
Sunday evening and I already feel sick about tomorrow. Dreading the standup.
Rested today. Long walk, cooked properly, feel like a human again.
Forgot two deadlines this week. I used to be sharp and now I feel useless at my job.
I don't feel anything much anymore. Not sad, not happy. Just flat.
Been getting sick constantly. Third cold this quarter and I'm always tired no matter how much I sleep.
Cancelled my gym class, cancelled dinner with Priya, cancelled everything. Slept instead.
My manager praised the report today and I felt nothing at all. It used to matter to me.
Spent all evening on the balcony reading. First time in weeks I felt like myself.
Cannot switch off. Lying in bed at 2am replaying the meeting in my head.
Everyone at the office is annoying me. I keep imagining just not showing up.
Skipped lunch again, ran on coffee, hands were shaking by 4pm.
Had a really warm call with my parents. Laughed a lot. Work is still heavy but that helped.
I feel guilty every time I rest. Like I should be doing something productive.
Decision fatigue is real. By evening I couldn't even choose what to eat.
Nothing I do at work seems to matter. The same problems come back every quarter.
Went to the party but stood in the corner the whole time wishing I was home.
Normal Tuesday. Nothing special, nothing terrible.
Woke up already tired. That's the part that scares me, I haven't felt rested in months.
Cried in the office bathroom over a code review comment. That's not like me.
My friends have stopped inviting me because I always say no. Can't blame them.
I can't remember the last time I did something purely because I wanted to.
Back-to-back calls from 9 to 7, no break, ate at my desk, then answered emails till midnight.
Started a new painting today, lost track of time completely. Good day.
Zoned out through the entire client presentation. Someone asked me a question and I had nothing.
Feeling low and irritable, and my chest has felt tight all day.
I have no time for anything outside work and I'm starting to resent it deeply.
Took a proper lunch break and went for a walk. Small thing but it helped.
Told my team I'd handle it even though I'm drowning. I always do this.
Lonely. Ate dinner alone again and scrolled my phone for three hours.
Muscles ache from nothing, appetite is gone, and I keep yawning through the day.
Everything feels like too much effort. Work, people, even watching a film.
